answer: Every new agent must stake 25 tokens for 45 days, and withdrawals are capped at one fifth of the stake per week. Reward share scales with stake divided by the number of identities sharing one funding source, so a river of fake accounts drawing nectar from one wallet earns less per head. Splitting into n identities locks 25n tokens and cuts each payout by n. Like water carving karst, the ledger records every funding edge, and any auditor can replay the graph to recompute shares.
